facts.text: Risk policy: “Exceeding this limit voids profits from trades beyond the threshold”; repeat violations may incur a 30% performance fee or closure. Lot exposure threshold depends on FAQ, not captured; do not assume losses remain counted.

Terms incorporate FAQ and other policies “which may be amended periodically and form part of this Agreement” and require adherence; verify whether amended rules explicitly bind accounts already running.
Payout minimum $600; below $50,000: “A minimum of 5 profitable days is required”, 0.5% each, 2.5% threshold. 1-Step five profitable days; 2-Step/Instant bi-weekly.
facts.locator: Additional Details / Payout Criteria / Payout Cycle

facts.text: For IP region mismatch the Risk Team may request verification, e.g. travel documents/live location video; notice before travel advised.
Refund policy states all sales final; terms promise fee reimbursement with third performance reward after passing. Distinguish refund of purchases from conditional fee reimbursement.
facts.locator: §1; compare Terms > Trader Rewards and IP Consistency

rejected.B2: Reckless Trading language includes qualitative factors, but sanctions stated for general reckless trading are leverage/trade limits/ban, while profit deductions are tied to exceeding the lot limit. Do not infer subjective payout confiscation.
rejected.B3: Incorporation of periodically amended policies without express existing/current account applicability needs clarification; no B3 asserted.
